name: Tactician
description: Balanced execution. Guards at 45% health; no wasted casts, no reckless spend.

name: Blitz
description: Front-loads every buff, guards only below 20% health, and skips telegraph penalties.

name: Bastion
description: Guards proactively at 75% health or on windups. +25% defensive cooldown recovery, 5% resource on block.

name: Weaver
description: Holds DoT payoffs until debuffs are active and never overwrites a long ailment.

name: Entropy
description: Utility economy is disabled and score variance swings ±35%. Triggers may ignore ICD.
